annotation.title_clean: Registrar's Circular No. 9 of 2024: Issue of the Guide on the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools by Court Users
annotation.title_en: Registrar's Circular No. 9 of 2024: Issue of the Guide on the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools by Court Users
annotation.authors_or_issuer: State Courts of the Republic of Singapore (Registrar)
annotation.summary_en: Singapore State Courts Registrar's Circular issuing a Guide on court users' use of generative AI tools from 1 October 2024. Use is permitted, but users remain fully responsible for accuracy, must verify citations, protect IP and confidential data, and may be asked to declare AI use; non-compliance risks costs or discipline.
key_provisions_or_claims: Generative AI use in court documents is permitted if the Guide is complied with.
Court users bear full responsibility for accuracy and must independently verify AI-generated content and citations.
AI must not be used to fabricate or tamper with evidence.
Court users must protect confidential information, personal data and IP.
Non-compliance may lead to personal costs orders, disregard of documents, or disciplinary action.
